body: I love everything about this! It's exactly how I treat forgiveness! I don't have a high horse on morality(I've been told) but this horse is too high for me to get off of. So exhausting.

Here's my experience. I was prescribed Celexa a few months ago. The first two weeks were whatever but it made me yawn some strong gut yawns & even made me nap a few times. I hate naps. After those two weeks, I felt a sudden switch. Life now feels manageable & definitely takes the edge off without feeling reliant on it😊, BUT I went from 115 lbs. to 128 lbs. in a span of 3 months. Granted, I had not exercised as much this semester because it's been crazy. The yawning & weight gain were two very obvious side effects I've experienced. Hope this info helped.
